title: Naturality under squares changing decalage interval endpoints
statement: Let \(C\) be abelian and \(U\) a filtered cochain complex with its decalage tower [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-tower]. Given \(a\le b\) and \(a'\le b'\) in the extended integers and any square \(\alpha:(a\le b)\to(a'\le b')\) in their arrow category, construct the induced morphism \(T_\alpha\) of the two tower cokernel short complexes. For every \(n\in\mathbb Z\), the cone-to-quotient cohomology comparisons satisfy \(H^n(\alpha)I_{a',b'}=I_{a,b}H^n(T_\alpha^3)\).

proof.text: Map both endpoint arrows into the tower. Functoriality and thinness of the indexing category give the square. Its cokernel map supplies the third component of a morphism of cokernel short complexes.

theorem filteredComplexDecalageIntervalIso_map
    (U : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ))
    {a b a' b' : EInt} (h : a ≤ b) (h' : a' ≤ b')
    (α : ComposableArrows.mk₁ (homOfLE h) ⟶ ComposableArrows.mk₁ (homOfLE h')) (n : ℤ) :
    (((filteredComplexDecalageSpectralObjectFunctor C).obj U).H n).map α ≫
        (filteredComplexDecalageIntervalIso U a' b' h' n).hom =
      (filteredComplexDecalageIntervalIso U a b h n).hom ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (filteredComplexDecalageIntervalHom U h h' α).τ₃ n
